beats.headline: KANDAHAR, 1999
beats.text: December 1999. A hijacked Indian plane on a Taliban runway, and three prisoners traded to bring the hostages home.

beats.headline: THE PRICE
beats.text: The hostages walked free. So did the three men.

beats.headline: THE CLERIC
beats.text: Within weeks, one of them founded Jaish-e-Mohammed.

beats.headline: THE CHAIN
beats.text: A parliament attacked. A journalist taken. A convoy bombed. Every link runs back to the same seven days.

beats.headline: THE BUTTERFLY EFFECT
beats.text: The Butterfly Effect. Now on The Sisodia Files.
